title: A51 Issue Route Register row
description: Schema for one row of analysis/canonical/core_controls/A51_issue_route_register.csv (and the discovery mirror). Columns are documented in skills/bsa-orchestrator/references/shared-control-surface-contracts.md (A51 Minimal Columns). Validation flow: governance.schemas.loader.iter_a51_rows(path) → list[dict]; each row dict is validated against this schema.

A51Ref.description: Stable identifier. Two recognized shapes: A51-NNN (numeric, simple register) or A51-XXX-NNN (category prefix like INJ, MISS, CNTR, BIN, BOUND followed by numeric).

IssueType.description: Closed enum per shared-control-surface-contracts.md. Adding a value requires editing that doc + this schema together. Categories: 'uncertainty' = unresolved doubt about a specific claim or value; 'contradiction' = two or more sources disagree (handled by claim-binder + Phase-3 contradiction-propagation contract); 'missing_source' = a referenced source is unreadable / unauthored / not yet provided; 'decision_needed' = stakeholder input required before downstream work can proceed; 'boundary_risk' = the boundary of analysis vs implementation is at risk of being crossed (architectural / scope concern); 'inventory_gap' = the artifact / source / reference inventory is incomplete in a way that's broader than a single missing source — e.g., a category of evidence is acknowledged-but-unsourced, an entire reference document set hasn't been produced yet, or a coverage gap on a known list of expected artifacts. Distinct from 'missing_source' in that 'missing_source' targets ONE specific source; 'inventory_gap' targets a CATEGORY or SET of expected items. Pilot-validated v1.1.1 — Sysco engagement raised inventory-gap routes as a distinct category from missing-source single-item routes. 'cross_tier_contradiction' = the orchestrator-emitted variant of 'contradiction' specifically for the reliability-tier-delta ≤ 1 contested rule — both A59 rows are at similar tiers, neither wins automatically, both are routed via A51 with this IssueType + BlockingStatus=hard until manually reconciled. Distinct from generic 'contradiction' so downstream filters (KPI roll-up, H3 / H4 packets) can route the contested-by-tier subset separately. Promoted to a first-class enum value in v1.1.1 to align with reliability_tier_spec.md §Conflict Resolution + the existing test_tier_conflict_scenarios coverage.

Severity.description: Severity tier. 4-tier as of v1.1.1 (was 3-tier through v1.1.0). 'low' = informational / minor; 'medium' = warrants attention but does not block; 'high' = blocks promotion until resolved when BlockingStatus=hard; 'critical' = exceeds 'high' — used for issues that block multiple downstream stages OR have customer-facing / contractual impact (e.g., contract-binding SLA breach, regulatory non-compliance, security exposure). Run-profile-gates use Severity in conjunction with BlockingStatus to decide promotion gating; 'critical' + 'hard' is the maximum-blocking combination. Pilot-validated v1.1.1 — Sysco engagement classified contractual-SLA risks as 'critical' rather than diluting the 'high' tier.

BlockingStatus.description: hard = blocks promotion until resolved or routed; soft = warning only; informational = annotation, no gating.

RaisedByStage.description: Pipeline stage that emitted this route. Aligned with — but not strictly identical to — A48.CurrentStage. A51 additionally accepts the prefixed `discovery.dN` forms (N=1..5) used by some discovery workers when they want to disambiguate from the bare `dN` orchestrator-state value (e.g., Sysco-style engagements where the discovery workers emit `discovery.d1` for traceability into runtime markers like `discovery.d1.ready.json`). The bare `dN` form remains valid for fixtures + orchestrator-level tracking; the prefixed form is for raised-by-this-discovery-step provenance.

RelatedSourceID.description: Optional cross-reference into A50_source_register.csv. Empty string is allowed (no linked source). Multiple sources may be joined by ';' or '/' inside a single cell.

RelatedClaimID.description: Optional cross-reference into A59_claim_register.csv. Empty string is allowed. Multiple claims may be joined by ';' or '/' inside a single cell.

NextAction.description: Free-form description of what needs to happen to resolve this. Required even for soft/informational items so the operator always knows the recommended next step.

ResolutionStatus.description: Lifecycle state. open = active; resolved = closed by upstream change; resolved_by_remediation = closed by in-workspace fix (e.g., source re-extracted, contradiction reconciled); superseded = replaced by another A51Ref; wontfix = accepted, no action planned. F6 (Sprint 5) will add a reconciliation auditor that flags rows still 'open' here while marker payloads / handoff packets refer to them as remediated.

x-bsa-csv-columns-order._comment: Canonical column order for A51 CSV. Producers should write columns in this order for stability; consumers tolerate any order via DictReader. The loader's iter_a51_rows enforces order on read for diff cleanliness.
